decisions.option_label: APPROXIMATE CALIBRATION ACCEPTABLE ONLY WITH EXPLICIT BIAS DISCLOSURE
decisions.rationale: Empirical data across 12 stratified samples confirms that LUT spatial variation (E1 < 0.01%) is negligible, while nonlinear aggregation (E2 ~ 5.5-5.8% median, 0.24 dB) is systematic across all ocean scenes. Post-aggregation approximate calibration successfully removes the major 17% cross-swath incidence-angle confound while incurring a known, bounded, systematic underestimate. For semantic segmentation, this is defensible provided explicit bias bounds and edge-effect limitations are permanently disclosed.
disclosures: Systematic underestimate of linear sigma0 by ~5.5-5.8% median in ocean background
Localized peak errors up to 20-30% at high-contrast phenomenon boundaries and >100% on bright metallic point targets
Instrument radiometric accuracy (0.34 dB) is distinct from processing approximation error (0.24 dB)

decisions.topic: Zero / NoData Formal Classification & Mask Policy

empirical_basis.spatial_distribution: Exclusively left-border columns (col 0-6 or 0-20), 100% contiguous with swath boundary
empirical_basis.esa_specification: S1-RS-MDA-52-7443 Section 4.2.1 confirms non-imaged bounding-box margins are zero-padded

policy.source_mask_rule: Source mask PNG bytes on disk remain completely unmodified

empirical_basis.dominant_class_sampler_status: REJECTED (Fatal flaw: 6 classes never dominant in any tile)
empirical_basis.class_presence_sampler_status: REJECTED (Severe parent concentration: max multiplier 2.23x, CV 0.74)
empirical_basis.parent_balanced_sampler_status: REJECTED (Underexposes rare classes: HM only 1.2 tiles/epoch)

decisions.rationale: The hybrid sampler balances parent exposure fairness (limiting maximum parent multiplier to 1.37x) while guaranteeing that rare classes (such as HM, LWA, and Eddy) receive sufficient gradient signal per epoch.

decisions.topic: Class Loss Weighting Scheme & Double-Correction Risk
decisions.selected_scheme: Candidate E (Square-Root Median Frequency: sqrt(median_freq / freq))

empirical_basis.uncapped_median_freq_status: REJECTED (Severe double-correction: 1987x raw weight on HM, 3623x when combined with presence sampler)
empirical_basis.arbitrary_cap10_status: REJECTED as primary recommendation (arbitrary clipping discontinuity)

decisions.rationale: Sub-linear square-root scaling dampens extreme frequency disparities without artificial threshold discontinuities, preventing gradient instability on ultra-rare classes.

decisions.batchnorm_stability_guideline: With batch_size=8 (9 batches/epoch), standard BatchNorm running statistics can be noisy across scenes. GroupNorm (16 groups) or gradient accumulation (effective batch_size=16) is recommended.
